row: The University of Pittsburgh School of Health and Rehabilitation Sciences (or Pitt SHRS) is known for its excellence in academic and clinical education, and high-impact, multidisciplinary research. SHRS is home to five nationally ranked graduate programs and world-renowned faculty and clinicians within all areas of the health sciences. Our mission is to advance health and rehabilitation through research, teaching and professional service.
